purpose: Fixed five-notice diagnostic cohort for one-axis prompt ablations. It is not a performance gate and must never be replaced using model scores.
selection_contract: Selected only from organizer-provided dev labels, document structure/length, contract-law metadata, and organizer CSV lookup status; historical model predictions and scores were not used.

The cohort includes national and local contracts, one document that fits the 4,000-character baseline, documents beyond that baseline, single- and multi-document notices, CSV matched/not-matched cases, absence detection, and v24 comparison.
Scores diagnose directional prompt effects. Any candidate promoted from this probe must be rerun on dev_fast_panel_v1 and then dev-200.
